messages:
marta (Customer): Hi, hitting 404 when calling chat.create from our Node app after last night's deploy. Logs show: `Error: route not found: chat.create`

marta (Customer): We upgraded backend to v0.22.0 earlier but kept the SDK pinned to ^0.20.0. Not sure if that's the cause. Repro steps: `npm run start` -> call `client.chat.create({ conversationId, input })` -> 404.

marta (Customer): package.json snippet:
```
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/inference": "^0.20.0",
  "node": "18.x"
}
```

zoe (Support): sorry about that — can you paste the exact request payload & the full error stack? also can you try curling the API directly to see server-level behavior? `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/create` with your body. :mag:

marta (Customer): stack: `Error: 404 POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/create - {"error":"route not found"}`
Request body: `{ "conversationId": "conv_123", "input": "Summarize this" }`

zoe (Support): thanks. tagging @raj (SDK Eng) — looks like the API renamed endpoints in v0.22 to be more explicit (chat.createMessage) and param names changed (`conversationId` -> `threadId`). older SDKs map to the old routing table, so 404s if the server only exposes the new route.

raj (SDK Eng): confirmed. We rolled an API rename last night: `chat.create` -> `chat.createMessage` and normalized params. SDK v0.21.x includes a compatibility shim; v0.20.x does not.

raj (SDK Eng): Workarounds:
1) Quick: call the HTTP endpoint directly with the new route 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/createMessage \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{ "threadId":"conv_123", "input":"Summarize this" }'
```
2) Preferred: `npm install @redwood/inference@0.21.4` (compat shim) or upgrade app to SDK >=0.22 which maps new param names.

marta (Customer): ok will try 0.21.4 now. is there an official changelog entry? we want to avoid surprise next time.

alex (DevEx): changelog & migration notes are live: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog#v0.22.0 — we added a migration section for chat endpoint renames. We're also adding a deprecation banner next release.

marta (Customer): installed 0.21.4, restarted app, `client.chat.create(...)` now returns 200. thanks.

marta (Customer): follow-up: any guidance on pinning to avoid accidental break on minor server upgrades?

zoe (Support): we recommend pinning SDK major versions and testing against staging that mirrors production server version. also add a quick smoke test for critical routes after deploys.

raj (SDK Eng): created internal issue RL-1234 to add clearer runtime detection & a client-side compatibility warning when server advertises a mismatched routing table. assigning to SDK team.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: backend v0.22.0 -> all systems green. :white_check_mark:

marta (Customer): good to close for us. leaving this thread in case others hit it. :thumbsup:

zoe (Support): closing on our side too — feel free to reopen if you see anything else.
